balances, acting, dependent (laws of the flow and web); descended (the cohorts descend in the flow); gated and coupled (givers and cohort members depend on the family ds at need at least m); realized (a chosen course that 'ends' is realized as an overdraw of the family from a short stock); none (no cycle in what the choices show, i.e. they come from some strict order); stake (on the pairs met, a course widens another and adds to the own continuation only where it does not end and the other does). `ends` is an arbitrary predicate on courses, tied to the line only by `realized`.
